notes: Initial discovery (01/20): large contact center platform for retail & logistics verticals.
Primary pain: catastrophic queue backpressure during seasonal peaks (Black Friday, Prime Day) and incident bursts from third-party integrations.
"They see 6x traffic spikes and current bot tier falls apart — agents overwhelmed with triage work" — SVP Product (call 02/05).
Requirements summary: agent-assist + real-time ticket summarization to reduce AHT; tool-calling for CRM ops (update ticket state, fetch order history); deterministic fallback routing under overload.
Latency targets: median <200ms for embeddings/rerank lookups, tail (p99) <800ms sustained during 3x baseline; for generator flows median <300ms, p95 <900ms.
Throughput: baseline 4k reqs/min, target burst handling to 24k reqs/min (6x) with graceful degradation and no data-loss.
Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for guaranteed burst capacity but wants clear unit economics and tooling to reduce token spend (batching, prefix cache).
Security: must support VPC private endpoints, customer KMS, SSO with SAML, and audit logs forwarded to Splunk. EU data residency required for subset of logs/recordings.
Preferred models: open Llama-family variants for reranking & embeddings (quantized), guarded LLMs for assistant; fallback plan to smaller quantized variant during spikes.

Proposed Redwood approach: dedicated GPU pool for core traffic, autoscale policy with pre-warm burst nodes, KV prefix caching for high-frequency customer prompts, model variants + smart routing, and canary rollout for new policies.
Quote from SE: "We need a runbook for escalations during spikes and an SLO ladder — 99/95/50 breakdowns."
POC ask: 1) simulate 6x seasonal burst for 48 hours, 2) validate KV caching hit rates and latency improvements, 3) verify tool-calling reliability under backpressure (retry/backoff semantics).
Notes on integrations: Salesforce case updates via tool-calling (read/write), AWS S3 attachment retrieval, and Datadog tracing hooks required.
Risks called out: legal around storing conversational transcripts in EU region; current SOC2 cert in process (expected Q2), iso27001 desired.
Sales motion: PLG -> evaluation -> enterprise deal; AE to coordinate legal, security, and infra for POC sign-off.
Recent ask: deliver expected cost per peak hour and a sample SLA for 99.9% availability during burst periods (email 03/03).
